mapper.select: select id, from instance_risk_metric_minute where app_id = #{appId} and collect_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime} order by instance_id, collect_time

select m.id, m.collect_time, m.app_id, m.instance_id, m.ip, m.port, m.role, m.used_memory, m.max_memory, m.total_system_memory, m.mem_frag_ratio, m.keys_count, m.expires_count, m.avg_ttl, m.connected_clients, m.rejected_connections, m.keyspace_hits, m.keyspace_misses, m.expired_keys, m.evicted_keys, m.latest_fork_usec, m.rdb_last_bgsave_time_sec, m.aof_delayed_fsync, m.instantaneous_ops, m.net_input_bytes, m.net_output_bytes, m.used_cpu_sys, m.used_cpu_user, m.cluster_my_epoch from instance_risk_metric_minute m join ( select instance_id, max(collect_time) as latest_time from instance_risk_metric_minute where collect_time >= #{sinceCollectTime} group by instance_id ) latest on latest.instance_id = m.instance_id and latest.latest_time = m.collect_time where m.collect_time >= #{sinceCollectTime}

select min(id) as id, min(collect_time) as collectTime, app_id as appId, instance_id as instanceId, ip, port, max(role) as role, max(used_memory) as usedMemory, max(max_memory) as maxMemory, max(total_system_memory) as totalSystemMemory, max(mem_frag_ratio) as memFragRatio, max(keys_count) as keysCount, max(expires_count) as expiresCount, max(avg_ttl) as avgTtl, max(connected_clients) as connectedClients, max(rejected_connections) as rejectedConnections, max(keyspace_hits) as keyspaceHits, max(keyspace_misses) as keyspaceMisses, max(expired_keys) as expiredKeys, max(evicted_keys) as evictedKeys, max(latest_fork_usec) as latestForkUsec, max(rdb_last_bgsave_time_sec) as rdbLastBgsaveTimeSec, max(aof_delayed_fsync) as aofDelayedFsync, max(instantaneous_ops) as instantaneousOps, max(net_input_bytes) as netInputBytes, max(net_output_bytes) as netOutputBytes, max(used_cpu_sys) as usedCpuSys, max(used_cpu_user) as usedCpuUser, max(cluster_my_epoch) as clusterMyEpoch from instance_risk_metric_minute where collect_time >= #{sinceCollectTime} group by app_id, instance_id, ip, port

select collect_time as collectTime, app_id as appId, instance_id as instanceId, ip, port, role, used_memory as usedMemory, max_memory as maxMemory, total_system_memory as totalSystemMemory from instance_risk_metric_minute where collect_time >= #{sinceCollectTime} and role = 1 order by collect_time

select instance_id as instanceId, collect_time as collectTime, used_cpu_sys as usedCpuSys, used_cpu_user as usedCpuUser, instantaneous_ops as instantaneousOps from instance_risk_metric_minute where app_id = #{appId} and collect_time in ( select t.collect_time from ( select distinct collect_time from instance_risk_metric_minute where app_id = #{appId} and collect_time >= #{sinceCollectTime} order by collect_time desc limit 2 ) t ) order by instance_id, collect_time

select app_id as appId, instance_id as instanceId, ip, port, max(used_cpu_sys + used_cpu_user) - min(used_cpu_sys + used_cpu_user) as cpuDelta, timestampdiff(second, str_to_date(min(collect_time), '%Y%m%d%H%i'), str_to_date(max(collect_time), '%Y%m%d%H%i')) as spanSeconds from instance_risk_metric_minute where collect_time >= #{sinceCollectTime} group by app_id, instance_id, ip, port having spanSeconds > 0
select min(collect_time) from instance_risk_metric_minute where app_id = #{appId}
mapper.delete: delete from instance_risk_metric_minute where collect_time < #{collectTime} limit 5000
